headline: AZZZ Speaks of Labor Shortage: We Need Managed Migration, Not Blanket Bans
summary: Slovakia's labour market faces a serious worker shortage that will deepen in coming years, according to the employers' association. Retiring large birth cohorts and few young entrants will shrink domestic labour supply.
why: Labour shortages raise wage pressure and can constrain output in manufacturing-heavy economies such as Slovakia, which affects corporate costs and growth.
